checkpoints.name: maximal_zoomout_count
checkpoints.description: Theorem 5.26 of Minzer-Zheng (STOC 2024, arXiv 2404.07441v4): at most (160/delta) C^{-2} q^{100 (t-1)! (10/delta)^2 l / xi} (C, 1/5)-maximal zoom-out function pairs of codimension <= 10/delta on Q, under the packaged Lemma 5.24 (ManyZoomoutsRefinement) and Lemma 5.18 (GenericZoomSampling), with n >= 2^100 q^l, l sufficiently large, r1 <= 10/delta, C >= q^{-2(1-delta^3) l} (see tests/reference/concept-ledger.md).
